title: Death Note
synopsis: Light Yagami, an ace high school student, stumbles upon a mysterious supernatural notebook that can kill anyone whose name is written in it. When he attempts to eliminate crime worldwide as the god 'Kira', legendary detective L steps in to stop him.

synopsis: After his hometown is destroyed and his mother is killed by Titans, Eren Jaeger vows to cleanse the earth of the giant humanoids that have brought mankind to the brink of extinction.

title: Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World
synopsis: Suddenly summoned to a fantasy world, Subaru Natsuki discovers that each time he dies, he rewinds back to a 'save point' in time. Armed only with Return by Death, he fights to save the silver-haired half-elf Emilia and his allies.
